problem: Find all of the subsets of $A={x,y,z}.$
worked_solution:
To find every subset of $A,$ we list out every combination of elements within $A.$

We can use the following diagram to visualize the process:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071627/assets/1d7c11586a8fff5f63d46d936fd32c7b5fbfc33a406ddf268bfdd934fe787cdf.png)

Note that we must include the empty set since it is a subset of every set.

By doing this, we get

$$
∅,{x},{y},{z},{x,y},{x,z},{y,z},{x,y,z}.
$$
